Place Zebra's official BrowserPrint-3.1.250.min.js file in this folder.

Expected deployed path:
/vendor/zebra/BrowserPrint-3.1.250.min.js

Download the official Browser Print JavaScript Library from Zebra:
https://www.zebra.com/us/en/support-downloads/software/printer-software/browser-print.html

Do not rename the file unless REACT_APP_ZEBRA_BROWSER_PRINT_JS_URL is configured to match the alternate location.
